additional_written_results: For every even n>=2, a(n) is 3 modulo 6 at powers of two and 0 otherwise
For n>=2, [x^n](B composed with B)=-4c_n and [x^n]((A-A^2) composed with (A-A^2))=4*5^(n-2)c_n; both have dyadic valuation s_2(n)+1
For every integer t, q=1+4t gives a unique integral normalized solution; with M=abs(2t+1), every even-index coefficient is M modulo 2M at powers of two and 0 otherwise

formal_statements.scope: Existence; for every rational A satisfying IsGF and every n>1, an integer coefficient representative whose residues modulo 6 are neither 1 nor 5
Existence; for every rational A satisfying IsGF and every n>=1, an integer coefficient representative odd exactly when n is a power of two

formal_scope: The two exported declarations concern the original parameter q=5. The stronger even-index congruences, companion results and parameter family have written proofs in note.tex.
